definitions.explanation: A deep-seated feeling of resentment or hatred, often so strong it is believed to persist even after death. Frequently used in discussions of ghosts and supernatural themes.

examples.japanese: {怨念|おんねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{籠|こ}もった→籠もる：07414_komoru⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This is a place filled with lingering resentment.

{怨念|おんねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{晴|は}らす→晴らす：10538_harasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{復讐|ふくしゅう}した→復讐：12512_fukushuu⟧。
